title: 20260920-livework

frames.why: Blurred upward-tilted shot of a room with a white shelf unit; the top of a black chair back and a lilac hooded garment fill the lower frame, but no part of a person is visible.
A man's head, shoulders and dark t-shirt fill the center of the frame, facing the camera, with an earbud in his left ear.
Same man's face and upper torso centered in frame, looking toward the camera.
Close head-and-shoulders view of the man, eyes angled downward, dark shirt visible.
Blurry, tilted view of the shelf unit and ceiling; only an empty chair back and a lilac garment draped over it in the lower-left corner, no person in the shot.
Nearly identical blurred room view — shelf, ceiling, air conditioner, and an unoccupied chair with a lilac garment at lower left; nobody in frame.
The man occupies the right side of the frame in profile, head tilted down, bare forearm and dark t-shirt clearly visible.
His face and shoulder fill the right side of the frame, arm raised across the lower right, looking off to the side.
Back and side of his head with an earbud, neck and shirted shoulder at the right edge of the frame.
His head and upper body on the right side of frame, face toward the camera, mouth open mid-speech.
Head, neck and shirted shoulder on the right side, leaning against a chair back, face turned toward the camera.
He leans back with head tilted up, hand raised near his head and a watch on the wrist at the right edge.
Seated against the chair headrest, face toward camera, raised fist and wristwatch at the right of frame.
Head and shoulders centered, facing the camera, dark shirt and shelf behind him.
Face fills the center of the frame at close range, eyes toward the camera, shoulders in dark shirt at the bottom.

summary: Thirteen of fifteen frames clearly show the same man in shot — face-on, in profile, or from behind — in a small room with a white shelf unit. Two frames (4 and 5, around 15–18 minutes) are readable enough to show only an empty chair with a garment draped on it and no person, and one early frame (0) is similar though blurrier. Otherwise attendance is continuous across the session.
